description: Startup default alive / runway — Is a startup default alive or default dead? Month-by-month simulation of cash, revenue growth and expenses (no new funding): months to profitability, zero-cash month, flat-burn runway, lowest cash point, the monthly growth rate needed to survive, the expense cut that would make it default alive, and a quarterly projection. Params: cash=, monthly_expenses=, monthly_revenue=, growth= (monthly revenue growth %), optional expense_growth= (%/month). Accepts 250k / 2m shorthand. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_default_alive
